rationale: Roberts is likely to keep assignment and write narrowly, emphasizing ordinary accrual doctrine and APA § 702’s plaintiff-specific “adversely affected” requirement while deflecting finality concerns to remedies/equity. Alito is very likely to dissent on administrability/sovereign-immunity grounds, and one or two separate concurrences (especially from Thomas or Gorsuch) may press a more textualist, anti-repose framing.
